# Knowledge Proficiency

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/KnowledgeProficiency>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified, leveled depth-of-knowledge of an agent toward a subject — the [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator) binding {agent} × {subject} × {level on a scale} × {interval}, mirroring expertise's [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](gmeow-SkillProficiency.md). Founded on the [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) mode (documentation, not an axiom — [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)); the mode and this relator are DIFFERENT individuals, never double-typed. Flat-first: the four-level knowledge spectrum ([`gmeow:isAwareOf`](../properties/gmeow-isAwareOf.md) … [`gmeow:hasMastered`](../properties/gmeow-hasMastered.md)) is the cheap surface; promote to a [`KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) when level, scale, temporal scope, or standpoint matters. Suppression not deletion ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)): lapsed knowledge is recorded as a closed interval / [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false, never deleted. Boundaries, documented WITHOUT axiom bridges ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): cognition (knowing, objectual) ⊥ epistemics (believing, propositional); cognition ⊥ expertise (knowing ⊥ can-do — [`gmeow:hasSkill`](../properties/gmeow-hasSkill.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:knowsAbout`](../properties/gmeow-knowsAbout.md) touches the axes at one rung only).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Dunning Kruger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/cognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/cognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-dunning-kruger)#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-dunning-kruger

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: the Dunning–Kruger case, modelled as COEXISTING standpoint-indexed
# claims (Principle 9), never a global verdict. Sam self-assesses MASTERY of
# quantum computing; an external assessor rates the same knowledge merely as KNOWS-ABOUT.
# Two gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency relators over the same (agent, subject), at
# divergent gmeow:KnowledgeLevel values, each indexed by gmeow:accordingTo to a
# different vantage. GMEOW records the disagreement; it does not adjudicate it.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/cognition/> .
@prefix wd:    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> .

# --- Self-attributed: Sam, by Sam's own lights, has MASTERED quantum computing.
ex:samQuantumSelf a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent   ex:sam ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject wd:Q192995 ;         # quantum computing
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel   gmeow:knowledgeMastered ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale   gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:accordingTo                 ex:sam .             # self-attributed vantage
```

### Knowledge Proficiency

- **Source:** [`slices/core/cognition/examples/knowledge-proficiency.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/cognition/examples/knowledge-proficiency.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-knowledge-proficiency)#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-knowledge-proficiency

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: the reified knowledge tier. The flat spectrum (gmeow:hasMastered
# &c.) says HOW DEEP; the reified gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency adds the SCALE it is
# read against, a temporal interval, and a standpoint — the promotion path when
# level, scale, time, or vantage matters (Principle 4). Suppression, not deletion:
# lapsed knowledge is a CLOSED interval with gmeow:displayable false, never removed
# (Principle 10). The mode (gmeow:CognitiveState) and the relator
# (gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency) are DIFFERENT individuals — never double-typed.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/cognition/> .
@prefix wd:    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- Promote to a reified proficiency: depth read on an explicit named SCALE,
#     over a temporal interval. The flat hasMastered above and this relator
#     coexist; gmeow:pairsWith links the two forms.
ex:adaPython a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent    ex:ada ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject  wd:Q28865 ;       # Python
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel    gmeow:knowledgeMastered ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale    gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval ex:adaPythonSince ;
    gmeow:displayable true .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a depth-of-knowledge fact needs its own level, rating scale, temporal scope, or standpoint to be first-class — the reify-on-demand promotion of the flat knowledge spectrum ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)), and the construct that records lapsed knowledge by closing its interval rather than deleting it ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the 80% case where an agent simply knows a subject to some depth — assert the flat [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](../properties/gmeow-isAwareOf.md) … [`gmeow:hasMastered`](../properties/gmeow-hasMastered.md) spectrum and promote only when context must be first-class; avoid double-typing it with the [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) mode (different individuals, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)); avoid it for the can-do axis (that is expertise's [`gmeow:SkillProficiency`](gmeow-SkillProficiency.md)).

### How to use

- Mint one [`KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) per (agent, subject, level, scale) tuple, binding the five roles ([`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyAgent.md) / …Subject / …Level / …Scale / …Interval); read [`gmeow:pairsWith`](../properties/gmeow-pairsWith.md) from the flat spectrum properties to surface the promotion path in gmeow describe, and carry contested or attributed depth on the statement layer via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md).

### Examples

- ex:lillithPythonKP a [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md); [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyAgent.md) ex:lillith; [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencySubject.md) ex:python; [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyLevel.md) [`gmeow:knowledgeUnderstands`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeUnderstands.md); [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale`](../properties/gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyScale.md) [`gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth`](../individuals/gmeow-scaleKnowledgeDepth.md).
